description: How does a city of 21 million listen? Beijing's 12345 hotline handles over 70,000 requests every day. One call reveals one person's problem, thousands can show where the city needs to change. Here is how Beijing uses a public hotline, big data and AI to turn everyday complaints into citywide solutions, with a little hotpot drama along the way. #EyesOn #Beijing #UrbanGovernance #SmartCities #AI
title: EyesOn | How does a city of 21 million listen?

description: "I think people must remember that things happened with cooperation." In 1909, an American engineer helped build Lanzhou's iconic Yellow River bridge. title: American retraces family ties to century-old Yellow River bridge

author: New China TV
description:
A driver lost control after going into cardiac arrest in Changsha, central China.
Another driver steered his van to intercept the runaway vehicle, redirecting it toward the curb and away from motorcyclists.
Police and passersby rushed to perform CPR on the unconscious driver, who is now out of danger after being hospitalized. #Hero #Rescue #Changsha #EverydayHero #China #Heartwarming
title: Brave driver blocks runaway car to save unconscious motorist
